_comment: Per-character TTS voice. Keys are LLM1 character_id values. voice = Piper voice name (https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices), downloaded into models/ on first use. length_scale > 1 speaks slower, < 1 faster. Each voice has its own natural pace, so values are calibrated per voice so articulation rates (syllables/s, pauses excluded) keep the ratio Nass & Lee (2001) used for introvert : extrovert synthetic voices (184 : 216 wpm, 200 between) — see README. Characters not listed here use 'default', with speed adjusted by their OCEAN extraversion if given. arousal_rate: LLM2's Russell-circumplex arousal (-1 sleepy .. +1 excited) scales the pace: length_scale x (1 - arousal_rate x arousal).
